remarks: Discover exceptional living in this beautifully designed home, perfectly positioned across from a scenic pond and walking trails, offering stunning views and easy access to nature.  The thoughtfully planned layout includes a main-floor bedroom and full bathroom, making it ideal for guests. A side entrance and 9-foot basement ceilings provide outstanding potential for future basement development.  At the heart of the home is a spacious open-concept main floor featuring a central gourmet kitchen, bright dinette, inviting living room, walk-through pantry, and functional mudroom. The kitchen is finished with 41-inch soft-close upper cabinets, elegant quartz countertops, a double-compartment stainless steel undermount sink, and a chrome pull-down faucet with a water-saving aerator.  The living area is highlighted by a stylish 50-inch linear LED electric fireplace, while upgraded spindle railings along the open staircase create a seamless connection between the main & upper levels.  Photos are representative. (id:67522)
